capabilities: Toggles any note into an editable radial mind map in the same tab
Writes map edits back to the note as minimal line edits
Edits nodes in place: rename, add, delete, indent, reparent, reorder, fold, tick checkboxes
Draws annotations, embeds, videos, and linked notes on cards
Exports the map as SVG, PNG, or HTML with inlined images
extras: Full usage and development docs are in Chinese; requires Obsidian 1.5.7+. Fold state and focus are kept in plugin data, never in markdown, and unedited lines are preserved byte-for-byte including CRLF.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or edit a note's structure as a mind map without exporting it or creating separate files.
summary: Radial mind-map view that turns a note's headings and bullets into an editable canvas, writing every change back to the same .md file.
